items.exampleEn: The new medicine is still in clinical trials.
items.exampleZh: 這種新藥還在臨床試驗階段。

items.exampleEn: For some people, moving house can be a real trauma.
items.exampleZh: 對某些人來說，搬家可能是一種真正的創傷。

items.exampleEn: She works as a psychiatrist at a large hospital.
items.exampleZh: 她在一家大醫院當精神科醫師。

items.exampleEn: The hospital opened a new psychiatric ward.
items.exampleZh: 醫院開設了一個新的精神科病房。

items.exampleEn: The school offers remedial classes in math.
items.exampleZh: 學校開設數學補救教學課。

items.exampleEn: Experts did careful restorative work on the old painting.
items.exampleZh: 專家對那幅老畫做了細心的修復工作。

items.exampleEn: Patients collect their medicine at the hospital dispensary.
items.exampleZh: 病人在醫院的藥局領藥。

items.sentenceEn: The new psychiatric unit has twenty beds.
items.sentenceZh: 新的精神科病房有二十張床。

items.audioEn: The dispensary on the ground floor closes at six o'clock.

items.sentenceEn: Nursing students gain clinical experience in their final year.
items.sentenceZh: 護理系學生在最後一年累積臨床經驗。

items.sentenceEn: A quiet week by the sea felt truly restorative.
items.sentenceZh: 在海邊安靜度過一週，讓人真正恢復了元氣。

items.stemEn: Students who fail the test must take ____ lessons in the summer.
items.stemZh: 考試沒過的學生，暑假必須上補救課程。

items.stemEn: Psychologists study how childhood ____ can affect adult life.
items.stemZh: 心理學家研究童年創傷如何影響成年後的生活。

items.passageEn: Last year, a city hospital turned an empty roof into a garden. The idea came from a psychiatrist who noticed that many patients on the psychiatric ward rarely went outside. Clinical staff now take small groups to the garden every afternoon, and some patients say it is the best part of their day. Volunteers also run a remedial reading class there for children who are staying in the hospital for a long time. The garden is next to the dispensary, so visitors often stop there while waiting for medicine. The hospital hopes the garden will become a calm place for everyone.
items.passageZh: 去年，一家市立醫院把空著的屋頂改造成花園。這個點子來自一位精神科醫師，他注意到精神科病房的許多病人很少到戶外。現在臨床人員每天下午會帶小組病人到花園，有些病人說那是他們一天中最喜歡的時光。志工也在那裡為長期住院的孩子開設閱讀補救課程。花園就在藥局旁邊，所以訪客等領藥時常會去走走。醫院希望花園能成為每個人都能放鬆的地方。

questions.questionZh: 花園的點子是誰想出來的？

options: 為長期住院的孩子開閱讀補救課

items.promptZh: 那位精神科醫師寫了一本給青少年看的小說。
referenceEn: The psychiatrist wrote a novel for teenagers.
A psychiatrist wrote this novel for teenagers.
rubricZh: psychiatrist 是可數名詞，表示「精神科醫師」（例如 the psychiatrist、a psychiatrist 等）
「寫了一本小說」可寫，例如 wrote a novel、has written a novel 等
「給青少年看的」可寫，例如 for teenagers、for young people 等

items.promptZh: 這家公司採取了補救措施，修正帳單上的錯誤。
referenceEn: The company took remedial action to correct the mistakes on the bills.
The company took remedial steps to fix the errors in the bills.
rubricZh: 「補救措施」用 remedial，例如 remedial action、remedial steps、remedial measures 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 took 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：trauma 例句以水災為情境（the trauma of the flood），屬 §11-11 應避開的災難題材；建議換中性情境（例如 a car accident 亦屬沉重，可用 the trauma of moving to a new country 之類）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示避開災難，卡改 For some people, moving house can be a real trauma.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：mcq "Many people who survived the earthquake still suffer from ____." 同樣以地震災難為情境（§11-11），且與單字卡同為天災創傷，情境雷同。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 Psychologists study how childhood ____ can affect adult life.（心理學名詞的事實句）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："Sleep is restorative for both body and mind." 為保健主張（§11-30）；可改成主觀感受句，如 q11 的 "A quiet week by the sea felt truly restorative." 那種寫法。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示改用「修復」義 Experts did careful restorative work on the old painting.，釋義第一義改「修復的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："The new drug is still in clinical trials." 依 §11-16 drug 易被誤讀，建議改 "The new medicine…"。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 17：閱讀末句隱含療效；病人說新鮮空氣讓人恢復元氣也帶保健效果
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 末句改 The hospital hopes the garden will become a calm place for everyone.；restorative 那句改 it is the best part of their day

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 16：翻譯「壓力大就看精神科」帶就醫暗示
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改「她的哥哥是一位精神科醫師」，參考答案與評分要點同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：psychiatrist 是可數名詞，表示「精神科醫師」（例如 see a psychiatrist、go to a psychiatrist 等）／「哥哥」可寫，例如 older brother、elder brother 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 9：翻譯參考答案與 psychiatrist 卡都是「某人的職業是精神科醫師」；評分要點例子與參考答案對不上
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 翻譯改「那位精神科醫師寫了一本給青少年看的小說」，參考答案與評分要點同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（remedial）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u31-l01-q16；目標字沿用 remedial
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這家公司採取了補救措施，修正帳單上的錯誤。」、hintWords ["remedial"]、referenceEn ["The company took remedial action to correct the mistakes on the bills.","The company took remedial steps to fix the errors in the bills."]、rubricZh ["「補救措施」用 remedial，例如 remedial action、remedial steps、remedial measures 等","「修正」可寫，例如 correct、fix 等","說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 took 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 remedial 造一個句子，說說你或朋友上過的補救課程。」、referenceEn ["I took a remedial writing course when I started college.","My friend needed remedial help with her writing."]）
